description: This file defines the HolidayDao class responsible for data access operations related to Holiday entities within the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, searching, and deleting holiday records in the database, utilizing Doctrine's QueryBuilder and Paginator components.

classes.name: HolidayDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling Holiday entity database operations, including create, read, search, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: saveHoliday
methods.description: Persists a Holiday entity to the database, either creating or updating the record.

methods.name: getHolidayById
methods.description: Retrieves a Holiday entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getExistingHolidayIds
methods.description: Fetches existing holiday IDs from the database that match a list of provided IDs.

methods.name: searchHolidays
methods.description: Searches for holidays based on filter parameters and returns an array of Holiday entities.

methods.name: getSearchHolidaysPaginator
methods.description: Constructs a paginated query for holidays based on filter parameters, handling date range and recurrence considerations.

methods.name: getHolidayByDate
methods.description: Retrieves a recurring holiday by a specific date, considering whether the holiday recurs annually or is a one-time event.

methods.name: deleteHolidays
methods.description: Deletes multiple holiday records based on an array of holiday IDs.
